# 360 Coating Solutions

> Family-owned painting, coating and wall-design company serving Highlands Ranch
> and Colorado's Front Range. Two arms under one family: **360 Coating Solutions**
> (builder-grade coating systems for homebuilders) and **360 Painting & Wall
> Design** (luxury residential interiors, accent walls and color design).

## Who runs it

Tatiana and Andrés Gomez, a married couple who met in church in Colombia thirty
years ago. Both are engineers with 15+ years each in oil & gas production before
founding the company.

- **Tatiana Gomez** — Creative Director & High-End Residential Designer.
  Industrial engineer, MBA in global management. Leads residential design, color
  and wall design.
- **Andrés Gomez** — Principal of Operations & B2B Partnerships. B.S. Computer
  Science (University of Florida), ATP-certified pilot. Leads builder accounts
  and production operations.

Direct B2B collaboration with national and regional homebuilders including Toll
Brothers and Aspen View Homes.

## Services

- **Interior & exterior painting** — Interior finishes that wash clean for
  years; exterior systems specified for Colorado sun, hail and freeze–thaw.
- **Accent walls & wall design** — Geometric paneling, wood slats, shiplap and
  sculpted feature walls, designed for the room then built and finished by hand.
- **Color consultation & photorealistic renderings** — Clients approve the
  finished room before a brush is lifted.
- **Space & interior design** — Color, spatial planning and materials
  coordinated together.
- **Venetian plaster** — Three to four hand-troweled coats, burnished and
  sealed; stays beautiful 15–20 years with basic care.
- **Custom carpentry** — Cabinetry, built-ins, office fixtures, storage.
- **Custom millwork** — Crown molding, baseboards, chair rails, window casings.
- **Exterior facade design** — Palette designed around existing stone and brick;
  stucco, siding, trim and garage doors repainted.
- **New-construction production painting** — Full paint packages for production
  homebuilders, scheduled by phase.
- **Repaints & HOA compliance** — Color approvals and ARC paperwork handled
  end-to-end, including attending committee meetings on the client's behalf.
- **Commercial & multi-unit** — Evening and weekend scheduling available.

## Service area

Highlands Ranch, Lone Tree, Centennial, South Glenn, Columbine, Englewood,
Littleton, Glendale, Lakewood, Aurora and Denver, Colorado. Concentrated
presence in the Backcountry neighborhood of Highlands Ranch.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do you handle HOA and ARC color approvals?**
Yes — end to end. The team prepares color submittals, completes the paperwork,
and attends HOA and ARC committee meetings on the client's behalf.

**How long does a whole-home interior repaint take?**
Most homes finish in days rather than weeks. A recent Backcountry project
covered an entire main level and second floor in four days, including protecting
and moving furniture.

**Can I see the color before painting starts?**
Yes. Tatiana delivers photorealistic renderings so clients approve the finished
look before a brush is lifted.

**What makes exterior paint last in Colorado?**
Specification, not brand: primers that genuinely bond to the substrate, and
topcoats chosen for UV resistance and the moisture that surface actually sees.

**How long does Venetian plaster last?**
15–20 years with basic care, when hand-troweled in three to four thin coats,
burnished and sealed.
